answer: A farm faking 141 aliases needs 141 separate certificate records, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Food hygiene certificate with council inspection logs is the check: a certificate held while one kitchen passed inspections for years. The glacier check is what stops the copy-paste farm: The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The terrace record is public, the sonnet cost is per identity, and 141 aliases cost 141 times one honest seat.
